sourceValues.identity: native positive signed64 object or edge id; record/relationship type id qualifies identity
sourceValues.properties: JSON object keyed by native property id text; missing key is absent; explicit null cell is present null
sourceValues.scalarCells: UMF exact string, boolean, integer, decimal, timestamp and binary cells under admitted catalog facets; no precision-losing casts; canonical date cells under the explicit Truss Gregorian subset
sourceValues.containers: admitted flat and recursive scalar array/map cells retain order, map keys and absent/null distinctions
sourceValues.numeric: integer/decimal source text is validated before PostgreSQL numeric input; admitted signed64 and decimal(18,4)/(18,2) facets retain exact meaning
sourceValues.timestampComparison: umf-rfc3339-exact-instant/1.0.0; original token retained; instant key is [wholeSecondsText,fractionDigitsWithoutTrailingZeroes]
sourceValues.binary: canonical base64 text; byte equality uses decoded bytes
sourceValues.date: canonical Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD, years0001..9999; original tokens; C-collated equality; absent/null remain SQL UNKNOWN
sourceValues.indexedSubset: Exact singular string/boolean field equality using original property cells; authored single required string ordered keys with at most1024 UTF8 bytes, empty facets and a complete indexable key inventory. Valid longer, composite and nonstring keys remain stored unchanged and use the bounded legacy fallback.

graph.relationships: directed independent or owned, one admitted endpoint type pair, no association object or composition; every distinct edge id counts, including parallel edges
graph.ownership: acyclic owned forest; object root columns identify the rootless aggregate root; complete current root is validated in the caller statement snapshot
graph.rootAuthorization: every observed current or historical attribution root document must occur in binding.documents; its module reader is required before source buffering and final handoff; final query_scope rechecks the complete selected document scope
graph.relationshipKeys: complete authored endpoint keys, with tuple arity and exact scalar components preserved

entityMetadata.meaning: original creation and current version evidence, including descendant effects of an original ownership change; no synthetic child operation; nullable import metadata remains JSON null when absent
entityMetadata.history: exact original per-entity journal group and immutable owning attempt/transition; historical root interpretation never falls back to a live root

execution.snapshot: STABLE public data/fact shims and original STABLE sources use the caller SQL statement snapshot, including own pending writes. The separately invoked VOLATILE person guard observes current permissions; current authority is checked again at final handoff.
execution.binding: queryAbi pin is exact; installation id, actual runtime release id+sha256, accepted document revisions+sha256, catalog revision and native mappings remain byte-bound by the original compiled artifact
execution.wrongRuntime: execution refuses a different actual installation/runtime binding even when queryAbi is identical
execution.session: authenticated original person on host-supplied PostgreSQL connection; caller owns transaction; generated SQL runs with pinned pg_catalog,pg_temp search_path
execution.limits: maximumScanRows and maximumResultRows1..10000; maximumBytes1..16777216; legacy complete source bags retain pre-predicate scan bounds; compiler-selected exact string/boolean candidate sources validate every matched row within the same bounded candidate count/bytes before residual predicates; eligible complete single-string ordered keys seek at most pageSize+1 rows; unsupported or nonindexable inventory uses complete bounded fallback; native index traversal has statement/operation deadlines, not a claimed exact index-node bound
execution.refusals: invalid binding/profile or unsupported meaning, unauthorized owner/root, stale catalog/observation, malformed exact value, or resource limit refuses the whole query; no partial rows
execution.invocation: Finite public person invocation shims check current native family enrollment, original function owner and fresh original caller EXECUTE; source/fact implementations recheck selected current owners; native42501 remains an installation execution failure
execution.cursorDelivery: Explicit backend0.4.44 caller-owned insensitive portal removes the SQL result LIMIT while retaining a complete bounded source. Exact indexed candidate filters retain their scan/byte budget; an unlimited portal never uses a finite seek slice as the whole source. Unfiltered/unsupported sources retain ordinary complete scan/byte refusal. Native SRFs may buffer complete bounded sources before portal fetch; host batch sizes are not strict total-process memory or latency guarantees.
